documentation.subject: ${SERVICE_NAME}: readiness is failing
documentation.content:
The API answered `/v1/health/ready` with 503 because PostgreSQL did not respond.

Runbook: `docs/ops/deployment-runbooks.md`, "Readiness is failing".

First three commands:

    gcloud run services describe ${SERVICE_NAME} --region europe-west3 --format='value(status.conditions)'
    gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.service_name="${SERVICE_NAME}" AND jsonPayload.event="readiness_check_failed"' --freshness 1h --limit 20
    curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' "$(gcloud run services describe ${SERVICE_NAME} --region europe-west3 --format='value(status.url)')/v1/health/ready"

Stop condition: if readiness recovers on its own within one deploy cycle and no revision changed, this is the database provider, not the release. Escalate to the database provider's status page rather than rolling back.
